function.description: List your durable goals, newest first — LIVE ones by default (pass status='done'/'cancelled' for history); kind='ask' lists your owner asks.
function.name: goal_list

kind.description: 'goal' (default) lists goals; 'ask' lists your owner asks: the question, the goals it holds, and the answer once decided.

status.description: Filter: triage/waiting/ready/running/blocked/paused/done/cancelled. Omitted = LIVE goals only (triage/waiting/ready/running/blocked/paused); pass 'done' or 'cancelled' to see history. For kind='ask': open (default)/fulfilled/rejected/obsolete.
